title: Fee Waiver Approval SOP
summary: [SUPERSEDED] Legacy fee waiver guidelines allowing autonomous frontline reversals without mandatory reason categorization.
purpose: Provide fee reversal guidance for customer service staff under the 2025 retail fee framework.
scope: Branch bankers and phone customer care agents.

definitions.definition: Historical synthetic discretionary limit of $50 per customer per 12-month period.

sections.title: Autonomous Discretionary Waivers (Legacy Protocol)
sections.content: Bankers may reverse monthly service fees or overdraft fees up to $50 without manager sign-off or logging explanatory reason codes.
